This page runs the directory written by [Prepare](prepare.qmd). It does not
change the model or the settings. To change anything, go back to Prepare and
write a new run directory.

::: {.callout-note title="Before you start"}
- The run directory from Prepare.
- A computer with Palace, or with AEDT 2024.2 and a licence. See
  [Install SCGSim, Step 5](../../course/installation.qmd#step-5-set-up-the-solver-host).
- Plan for a long run. Our Palace run took about 4 hours on 8 MPI processes
  and peaked at about 45 GB of memory.
:::

## Step 1: Run the solver

If the solver runs on another computer, copy the **whole** run directory there
first. Then, from the run directory:

:::: {.panel-tabset group="solver"}

### Palace

```bash
cd .artifacts/SimplePad/pad-resonance-palace-01
bash run_palace.sh
```

The script first checks the configuration with `palace --dry-run`, then
solves.

### HFSS

```bash
cd .artifacts/SimplePad/pad-resonance-hfss-01
bash run_aedt.sh
```

The script starts AEDT, builds the model, solves, exports the results, saves
the project and closes AEDT.

::::

## Step 2: Return the directory

If the solver ran on another computer, copy the whole directory back,
including `metadata/` and the logs. A results file on its own cannot be
loaded.

For Slurm, MPI wrappers and failed runs, see
[Run a prepared model](../../course/execute.qmd).
